scope: Three sequential reviews of the completed software/offline-bundle compatibility changes. No hosting migration or platform collection changes.

rounds.focus: Version source, strict schema types, numeric and prerelease boundaries, signature contract
Signed incompatible manifests/catalogs and corrupt unused additional objects cannot replace the previous working resource receipt; archive and storage regressions
Publication preparation storage failure, cleanup and retry; publishing identity
rounds.finding: Interrupted direct manifest write leaves a partial manifest that blocks retry. Reproduced with a failing regression before the fix.
rounds.fix: Reuse write_metadata: write to a same-directory temporary file, flush/fsync, close, replace destination, and clean temporary file on failure. Signed bytes are verified before committing.

limits: No actual frozen executable build; embedded version selection simulated with __main__.
No Debian run or physical router installation. opkg/apk archives use signed offline fixtures.
Windows injected file-operation failures were checked; sudden power-loss durability not tested.
No online publication, offline package replacement, application restart, or platform-size result asserted.
conclusion: One reproducible publication-preparation storage failure fixed; no other reproducible issue found in reviewed scope. Round totals overlap and must not be added as unique tests.
